notes:
- **The player's bars no longer pause the film.** Clicking an empty spot on the
  faded bar at the top of the player, or on the control bar along the bottom,
  paused or resumed playback as if you had clicked the picture itself — easy to
  trigger when reaching for a button and missing it slightly. Those bars now
  keep the click to themselves; clicking the video still plays and pauses, and
  double-clicking it still goes fullscreen.
